decisions.reason: As a formwork profile system close to the established offer with its own website page for two years, it has likely resolved uncertainty favorably and remains a valuable option worth keeping at low cost.
The shuttering magnet block is a low-cost complementary accessory that is still on the market, so the option remains cheap to hold and its prospects are not clearly negative.
This magnetic formwork component has its own page, indicating it has demonstrated enough value to justify keeping the option open.
Because it appears to duplicate Product E and only received a website mention, the firm holds several similar options and should drop this weaker one to release resources for more promising projects.
